outcome: incidence of pelvic floor support issues
persistence of pelvic floor support issues
worse vaginal support (maximal vaginal descent >=0 cm)
cohort: Nulliparous women 18 years or older who delivered vaginally at 37 weeks gestation or more.
finding: Oxytocin during labor does not significantly increase the risks for the incidence or persistence of pelvic floor symptoms or worse vaginal support in the early postpartum period.
